reuse.why: Reads group notes from the existing notes table and adds the rule to the shared getBudgetableCategories; copyPreviousMonth still keeps its own filter chain over getBudgetData, so it needs a second membership check.

duplication.why: Tag detection is written once in getFixedGroupIds; only the short 'skip if group is fixed' check is repeated in copyPreviousMonth, which follows the pre-existing split between the two selection paths.

placement.why: The fixed-group rule sits in budget/actions.ts beside hasSavedTemplates and getBudgetableCategories, the tree's place for month-wide category selection.

scope.why: Only the selection rule, the cat_group column it needs in getBudgetData, and tests that cover every month-wide action.

maintainability.why: Clear and well tested across all four actions; the leftover two-path selection (getBudgetableCategories vs copyPreviousMonth's inline filters) remains a place where rules can drift.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses the notes table and the shared getBudgetableCategories selection.

disguised_duplication.where: None; the repeated membership check in copyPreviousMonth calls the same getFixedGroupIds.

one_place.where: The tag rule is defined once in getFixedGroupIds (FIXED_TAG) and used by getBudgetableCategories (setZero, averages, last-month spending) and by copyPreviousMonth; the membership check itself is applied in those two places.
